title: MiniMax H3 vs LTX 2.5

video.title: MiniMax H3 vs LTX 2.5 in ComfyUI

summary: MiniMax H3 and LTX 2.5 are both open-weight image to video models, and both generate their own speech and audio in the same pass. They ran head to head on one desktop, nine rounds each, with a winner called on every one.

Each round has the prompt each model was given, taken from the metadata ComfyUI saved into the clip, plus a frame from both results. Final tally: MiniMax H3 five, LTX 2.5 three, plus a bonus round on turn-based speech outside the count.
facts: 6 steps with the Turbo LoRA, simple scheduler
The stock two-stage image to video template
Five seconds from a single still, 24fps, audio straight out of the model

variants.label: MiniMax H3, 20 steps
variants.text:
The woman smiles and speaks.

Audio: The woman says "I hope you all have a wonderful day."
No Music

variants.label: MiniMax H3, 6 steps with Turbo LoRA
variants.text:
Close on the woman in the gold-rimmed glasses. She looks straight into the lens, her expression warming into a smile as she finishes, then holds the look. The camera holds steady with a very subtle push-in.

Audio: she says clearly, "I hope you all have a wonderful day!." Underneath, quiet indoor room tone and faint traffic outside. No music.

variants.label: LTX 2.5
variants.text:
The woman smiles and says "I hope you all have a wonderful day". 
No background music or sound.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: The default MiniMax workflow takes nearly four times as long as the six step version. There is some quality drop, but it is a good trade for the speed. LTX's default and reduced-step versions differ in quality too, with not much difference in generation time.

variants.label: MiniMax H3
variants.text: the woman is turning her head a little further toward the lens, her hair is lifting and settling in the wind and she is shifting her weight and going still, as wind moving across the rooftop and faint traffic far below continues underneath. The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5
variants.text: The woman is turning her head a little further toward the lens, her hair is lifting and settling in the wind and she is shifting her weight and going still, as wind moving across the rooftop and faint traffic far below continues underneath. The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: LTX had better prompt adherence here, with no stray audio. With MiniMax the woman turned fully and there was not much wind.

variants.label: MiniMax H3
variants.text:
The man is finishing his gesture and lowering his hand, the woman is nodding and glancing off to the side and both are settling back against the bench, as dry leaves moving on the ground and birds at a distance continues underneath. The camera is holding still.
No audio or talk. Only background sounds of the wind and leaves rustling.

variants.label: LTX 2.5
variants.text: the man is finishing his gesture and lowering his hand, the woman is nodding and glancing off to the side and both are settling back against the bench, as dry leaves moving on the ground and birds at a distance continues underneath. The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: MiniMax kept the camera still and had the right background sound, but it also added speech nobody asked for, and missed the glance and settling back against the bench. LTX zoomed in and had no background sound, but no hallucinated speech either.

prompts.title: Bonus: the couple, taking turns to speak

variants.label: MiniMax H3
variants.text:
The man is looking at the woman and talking. She listens and then responds back. Then both of them look away from each other.

Audio: He says clearly, "and that's why I had to leave." She replies "Oh, I understand now"

variants.label: LTX 2.5
variants.text: The man finishes explaining saying "..and that's why I had to leave". The woman then says "Oh I understand now". Then they both look away from each other.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: Both models read the mood very differently and both got the order of the lines right. MiniMax has the edge because both of them look away from each other at the end; in LTX they keep looking at each other.

variants.label: Both models
variants.text: the water is running down over the dark rock, mist is drifting slowly through the pines and the surface of the pool below is rippling, as running water close by and wind in the pines continues underneath. The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: MiniMax had some odd patterns in the water but was decent overall, and the ambient sound made sense. LTX replaced the ambience with music nobody asked for, and the water flow was too smooth in places.

variants.label: Both models
variants.text: The dog is turning its head toward the lens, it is shaking the water out of its coat and it is stepping forward through the shallows, as water moving around its legs, a single bark and reeds in the wind continues underneath. The camera holds static.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: MiniMax followed the prompt better: the dog shakes off the water and barks, though it barks more than once and the shake is slightly off. LTX missed the shake, and its single bark has no matching action.

variants.label: Both models
variants.text: The truck is pulling away along the highway, dust is rising behind the rear wheels and it is drawing away toward the horizon, as a low engine note, tyres running on tarmac and desert wind continues underneath. The camera is tracking the truck from the side, matching its speed.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: MiniMax changed lanes, which is odd for a truck already moving, and a man appeared in the driver's seat. LTX animated it as a pull-away from standstill instead of continued motion, but was more consistent.

variants.label: Both models
variants.text: The woman in the centre is beginning to speak while the other two listen, the man on the left is glancing across at her and she is finishing and looking back to the lens, as quiet room tone continues underneath. The woman in the centre says "Please consider leaving a like and subscribing to this channel." The camera is static.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: MiniMax felt more natural: the two listeners turn to the speaker just as she starts, then nod and smile. In LTX both turn before she has started talking, with artifacts around her mouth on "subscribing".

variants.label: MiniMax H3
variants.text: she is leaning in to the microphone and beginning to sing, she is holding the note with her eyes closing and she is easing back from the microphone, as the room's own reverb continues underneath. She sings "Rock a bye baby, on the tree top, When the wind blows the cradle will rock." The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5
variants.text: she is leaning in to the microphone and beginning to sing, she is holding the note with her eyes closing and she is easing back from the microphone, as the room's own reverb continues underneath. She sings "Rock a bye baby, on the tree top, When the wind blows the cradle will rock" The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: A personal call. MiniMax chose a lovely tune and good expressions. LTX followed most of the prompt but did not keep the camera still, and its choice of tune was weaker.

variants.label: Both models
variants.text: all four are leaning toward the microphone and beginning to sing together, they are holding the note in unison and they are easing back and going quiet, as the room's own reverb continues underneath. All four singers together sing "O my Love is like a red, red rose That’s newly sprung in June; O my Love is like the melody That’s sweetly played in tune.." The camera is holding still.

variants.label: LTX 2.5 negative
variants.text: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
variants.note: The stock negative prompt from the LTX template, left as it was.

verdict.text: Five seconds is too short for the whole verse. MiniMax got through the first line; LTX sang only the first three words.
